products.name: Eightfold AI
products.note: Talent intelligence platform; skills matching; DEI bias risk; high-stakes employment decisions

profile_text.body:
Eightfold is a talent intelligence company whose platform is designed to help HR leaders and recruiters find, screen, hire, and develop employees. The company describes itself as "the agentic talent intelligence company" and positions its core product, the Eightfold AI platform, as a comprehensive solution covering recruiting, talent management, and workforce deployment. The platform includes an AI Interviewer tool that conducts candidate interviews and generates summaries for recruiters, with Eightfold emphasizing that the AI supports but does not make hiring decisions, those remaining with human recruiters. The company reports that some customers have reduced time-to-fill by 33% and filled certain roles in as little as 1.3 days.

Eightfold places emphasis on responsible AI governance, stating that its AI is built and monitored against an independent, audited management standard, which it describes as the first of its kind. Independent auditors test the AI Interviewer for bias, and Eightfold states those results are made publicly available. The held facts note the platform carries relevance to DEI bias risk and high-stakes employment decisions, categories that align with the company's stated focus on audited, verifiable AI conduct in hiring contexts.
